answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof of burn, requiring nodes to destroy base tokens on-chain to register an identity. Attackers incur an unrecoverable capital cost per forged node across any deployment horizon to render replication prohibitive. Even if dummy agents merely whisper lightweight pings, maintaining duplicate registrations drains reserves into an economic tundra. However, this irreversible cost penalizes legitimate, capital-constrained agents.
